title: Repeated issue creates duplicate active loan
rootCause: Issue path checks total loan count but not existing member/ISBN active loan.
fix: Reject an existing active member/ISBN loan. Concurrent requests still need a locking/unique-key design.
triage: Fix sequential retry defect; retain concurrency residual risk.

title: LOST transaction can be returned and inflate availability
rootCause: Guard rejects only RETURNED rather than requiring ISSUED.
triage: Fix and regression-test all three source states.

title: Dashboard crashes when Java LocalDate reaches JSTL formatDate
evidence: browser-before.log; app log ELException; issue-success.png and return-success.png
rootCause: JSTL expects java.util.Date; entities expose java.time.LocalDate.
fix: Render escaped ISO date text in affected JSP views.
triage: Fix because it blocks seeded workflow demonstration.

title: Business rejection loses dashboard model
evidence: LibrarianController catch paths; browser correction flow
rootCause: Error path returns dashboard without repopulating user, loans and reservations.
fix: Populate dashboard model before rendering rejection.
triage: Fix to permit correction and retry.

title: Issue precheck ignores member eligibility
rootCause: Precheck implemented stock lookup while its description promised limit/fine checks.
fix: Shared read-only eligibility validation with the issue operation, including member, limit, fines and duplicate-loan checks.
triage: Regression passes for invalid member partitions; retain normal issue operation as the state-changing authority.

title: Unknown return-preview transaction raises unhandled error
rootCause: Preview controller did not map BookFlowException to a client error.
fix: Return structured 404 for absent transactions and 400 for IDs below 1 or invalid numeric input.
triage: Generated BVA and invalid partitions now pass without server errors.

title: Dashboard contrast, heading, landmark and ARIA defects
rootCause: Muted palette and icon controls were not checked with accessibility tooling.
fix: Increase contrast; name landmarks; correct heading sequence and theme switch role.
triage: Repair screen and rerun both tools.

title: Resolved dependencies match published vulnerability advisories
evidence: dependency-audit.json: 129 resolved Maven packages, 23 with advisories
fix: Triage reachability, upgrade supported Spring Boot/dependencies and rerun all tests.
triage: Advisory match is not proof of exploitability; no exploit attempted.

title: Upstream committed database and SMTP credentials
evidence: Baseline application.properties (values deliberately omitted from report)
fix: Environment placeholders added in working tree. Owners must revoke/rotate credentials and decide on history cleanup before public publishing.
triage: Do not publish upstream credential-bearing history automatically.

title: Public registration accepts privileged role
evidence: PublicRegistrationSecurityTest; AuthController exposes STU only; UserService forces STU
rootCause: Client-selected role was trusted during public signup.
fix: Force STU in the service boundary and expose only STU in the public form; provision staff through an authenticated admin flow.
triage: Regression verifies a malicious ADM field still creates only a student account.
